options.title: Tamagotchi: The Toy You Had to Keep Alive
options.first_line: Tamagotchi was a toy that died if you forgot to feed it, and kids still begged for one.
options.first_frame: A Tamagotchi egg on a keyring fills the frame, its tiny pixel pet blinking, with the label 'Tamagotchi'.

options.title: Bandai Sold Kids a Pet That Dies If You Ignore It
options.first_line: Bandai sold kids a pet that dies if they ignore it, and called it Tamagotchi.
options.first_frame: A row of colourful Tamagotchi eggs punches in one after another, a red stamp 'IT DIES' slamming over them.

options.title: Why Did Kids Love a Toy That Could Die?
options.first_line: Tamagotchi could die in your pocket, and that is exactly why everyone wanted one.
options.first_frame: A worn Tamagotchi in a child's hand, the screen pushing in close on the pixel pet.

why: It opens on a toy most viewers held themselves and asks a real 'how is that possible?' question (why kids wanted a toy that could die) without giving away the answer, so you stay to find out.
